propositions: Core ticket/store/read/write/config/import/export/maintenance/gate commands parse argv imperatively and lack shared argparse definitions, duplicating grammar that RP-05 eliminates by centralizing via S2a factories.

Each command's current grammar (positives, negatives, boundaries, missing/surplus arguments, option formats, global flags, end-of-options) must be captured and preserved exactly through migration to side-effect-free factories in src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/, with per-family unknown-token semantics (skip vs reject-exit-2) maintained and proven via negative tests.

Every core Route in _registry.py must wire parser_factory and have its _dispatch_* handler route through that factory, with no parallel imperative grammar remaining and no unrelated parser/handler resolved during execution.

Production-path behavior, persisted effects, diagnostics, stream output, and exit codes must show zero unapproved deltas, verified through subprocess/interface tests covering argv matrices, global output extraction, and malformed input.
